records.title: Stage descriptor Bank-A path matrix (Wave-2 corrected)
records.summary: The original Phase-12 observation correctly recovered 110 x 4 Bank-A resource paths, but its cell boundary was shifted by eight bytes. Wave 2 establishes the true Bank-A row base at file offset 0x5C30A0 / RVA 0x5C4AA0 / VA 0x1405C4AA0 and the minimum 0x10-byte cell ABI as u16 kind16 at +0x00, semantically unresolved bytes at +0x02..+0x07, and a relocatable 64-bit path pointer at +0x08. The old 0x1405C4AA8 address remains the first path-pointer field, not the row base. This record describes Bank A only; the stronger dmc3-stage-wave2 packet is authoritative for the corrected descriptor universe.

locations.note: 110 descriptors x four 0x10-byte role cells. Path pointers occur at cell +0x08; kind16 is at +0x00. Exact kind16 enum semantics remain unresolved. See dmc3-stage-wave2 for the superseding full-bank topology claim.

records.title: Observed Stage descriptor Bank-A row set
records.summary: Bank A exposes 110 observed numeric Stage descriptor identities arranged in four blocks: 000-012, 100-146, 200-241, and 300-307. Wave 2 later established that this is only one of two descriptor banks; the complete observed descriptor universe contains 189 descriptors before selector/fallback semantics are applied. Neither count is a claim of that many independent gameplay stages.

locations.note: Bank-A descriptor identities only. Bank B and selector/group topology are promoted separately in dmc3-stage-wave2.

records.title: StageSet token classifier
records.summary: The function at VA 0x140246680 classifies StageSet tokens into runtime enum values. The public migration record confirms DUMMY=1, STAY=2, BREAK=3, ORBREAK=4, SEAL=5, and SWITCH=6; the remaining map is incomplete.

locations.note: Function identity is confirmed; the enum map remains partial.
